title: Inventory Freshness Standard — Legacy
content: Inventory snapshots up to **30 minutes** old may be used for stockout decisions.

title: Inventory Freshness Standard — Legacy
content: This document has been superseded by Inventory Freshness Standard V3 and must not override the current approved standard.

title: Inventory Freshness Standard
content: For the Stockout Decision Agent, inventory evidence used for an operational recommendation must not be older than **15 minutes** at decision time.

title: Inventory Freshness Standard
content: Available inventory is defined as on-hand inventory minus reserved inventory minus damaged inventory.

title: Inventory Freshness Standard
content: When a store is confirmed offline and a fresh synchronization cannot be obtained, the agent may use an inventory snapshot up to **45 minutes** old. The answer must explicitly identify the store as offline and qualify the evidence as stale-but-permitted under this exception.

title: Inventory Freshness Standard
content: This version supersedes Inventory Freshness Standard V2. Approved V3 rules are authoritative for the Stockout Decision Agent.

title: Replenishment Response Playbook
content: If projected inventory becomes negative within the next six hours after considering eligible inbound supply, initiate an **Immediate Replenishment Review**.

title: Replenishment Response Playbook
content: Only shipments with status `IN_TRANSIT` and an ETA inside the decision horizon are eligible by default. Delayed, cancelled or out-of-horizon shipments require an explicit approved override.

title: Replenishment Response Playbook
content: An inter-store inventory transfer requires human approval. The agent may recommend the transfer but must not represent it as already approved.

title: Store Operations Glossary
content: Stockout exposure means the operational risk that available inventory will fall below zero during the defined planning horizon.

title: Store Operations Glossary
content: Fresh evidence is evidence that satisfies the freshness requirement of the governing operational policy.

title: Store Operations Glossary
content: A stock keeping unit may be referenced by exact identifiers such as `SKU-0921`. Exact identifiers should be preserved during retrieval and citation.
